name: constant_rom_T8
purpose: WS-B independent constant-weight exploration. Fix the exact training parameters at compile time, remove parameter AXI/reader/transformer/FIFOs/private write ports, and keep W21 compute, raster order, quantization and replicate padding. The new srcnn_rom top has only image input/output and control ports. Runtime-loaded W21 remains the mainline. Require exact bank equivalence before synthesis, all 13 course Set14 images, then two-frame same-weight/changed-input RTL and routed gates.
